rundown: Sooners beat Rebels 24-17 at Memorial Stadium (Norman, OK) in Norman, OK. Sooners led 14-7 at the half and never looked back. The 1st quarter decided it: Sooners won it 14-0.
Scoring: Rebels 2 touchdowns and 1 field goal; Sooners 3 touchdowns and 1 field goal. The last score: L. Carneiro 41 yd FG GOOD (4th quarter, 0:42).

Leading the way — Rebels: Trinidad Chambliss 14/27, 127 yds, 1 TD, 11 car, 84 yds; Caleb Odom 4 rec, 56 yds, 1 TD. Sooners: John Mateer 10/19, 111 yds, 16 car, 70 yds, 1 TD; Rocky Beers 4 rec, 39 yds.
Where Sooners won it: they held the ball 36:31 to 23:29.
Against the closing line (Draft Kings): Sooners closed as 2.5-point favorites and covered by 4.5; the total closed at 48.5 and they combined for 41, under by 7.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 15, 12:55 PM ET. It had Rebels 62% and Sooners 38%, projecting Rebels 26.4 – Sooners 21.6 (48.1 total, Rebels by 4.8).

Final: Rebels 17 – Sooners 24. Wrong winner: it had Rebels at 62%, and Sooners (38%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Rebels came in with a 34% above average attack and a 30% stingier than average defense (6-3, 33.8 scored and 26 allowed a game over 9 games), worth about 170 and 179 games of evidence. Projected to score 26.4, they scored 17 (−9.4 points, 36% under); projected to allow 21.6, they allowed 24 (+2.4 points, 11% over).

Sooners came in with a 20% above average attack and a 23% stingier than average defense (5-4, 22.1 scored and 19.2 allowed a game over 9 games), worth about 171 and 177 games of evidence. Projected to score 21.6, they scored 24 (+2.4 points, 11% over); projected to allow 26.4, they allowed 17 (−9.4 points, 36% under).

The bigger miss was Rebels' scoring (-9.4 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 41 against 48.1 projected (-7.1), about the 32nd percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±15.5).

Margin: Sooners by 7 against Rebels by 4.8 projected, about the 78th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±15.3).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:

MISS ML (+114) at +114: the algo gave it 47% vs 45% fair (+1.7 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 45%). MISS +2.5 (-105) at -105: the algo gave it 51% vs 49% fair (+1.9 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. OVER 48.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 49% vs 50% fair (-0.1 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 48.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 51% vs 50% fair (+0.1 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 84% of bets on Rebels, 92% of the money — Sooners covered; total: 61% of bets on the over, 66% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 71% of bets on Rebels, 84% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Rebels, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.804 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +10.5 points. It counts toward CFB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 129 graded CFB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -1.3 points. Team corrections so far: Rebels attack ×0.960, defense ×1.040 (3 games); Sooners attack ×1.018, defense ×0.960 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
